Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 15, "heading": "VII
UNE NUIT DE NOCES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u015-b0062", "target": "«Я смогу полюбить только того, кто сумеет меня защитить.»", "source_sha256": "5715bb51db1e573a0b4e706056f1aca2ff1067134b1867ac1c02af2ad40d92f1", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u015-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f4f7a535a6666288979e918ba216569c2e7ab2194cd3f8351a5c9d4a5d617d51"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u015-b0063", "target": "Гренгуар покраснел и принял это к сведению. Было очевидно, что девушка намекала на ту малую поддержку, которую он оказал ей в критический миг два часа назад. Это воспоминание, изгладившееся из его памяти другими приключениями вечера, вернулось к нему. Он хлопнул себя по лбу.", "source_sha256": "d664f51179ebd815982b1a097199490726bb3e361eeac7508db1653c9e01066b", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u015-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "90b1c0c3916a512ca487ce77cd02294b45bb25c41c7377ada05d8c2c0dc05fe6"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 2, "chapter": 7, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u015-b0064", "text": "«À propos, mademoiselle, j'aurais dû commencer par là. Pardonnez-moi mes folles distractions. Comment donc avez-vous fait pour échapper aux griffes de Quasimodo?»", "sha256": "ee8d7e66d706b04fabbec975cf83c987acbde24a345e464011e2df7ec72eb875", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [876], "source_xml_sha256": "fcd7dc1bb74cdf3fe967b920907936ff4ee04223c2aa5468aaa8ed4c50b9ee98", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0065", "text": "Cette question fit tressaillir la bohémienne.", "sha256": "17e7c278420d53a38fc416b1095c495d3792220f20c1ef7d9cb908daf28921e2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [877], "source_xml_sha256": "5e78bffc3de5595f306230cf26a445a7c42f7ff12525c941d754e1484bef47ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0066", "text": "«Oh! l'horrible bossu! dit-elle en se cachant le visage dans ses mains; et elle frissonnait comme dans un grand froid.", "sha256": "72694b85d6d1105e91a67c80a449fecf56d864a463e56a1dee77e9f7012acd68", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [878], "source_xml_sha256": "85234456d4df9d09aac653fd3edc50bf6da78c462881b8dd274d5300d80d0fdd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0067", "text": "—Horrible en effet! dit Gringoire qui ne lâchait pas son idée; mais comment avez-vous pu lui échapper?»", "sha256": "1d2cd04f604e33ba462a5dbebc097ad211600e332de77180342316f38e0b5e28", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [879], "source_xml_sha256": "81fc14de5be941fce37c30a1016179de90eb057748f101db63da673d9ab17eb7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0068", "text": "La Esmeralda sourit, soupira, et garda le silence.", "sha256": "8647803f3679c3b82784515e4320a7fba5a0533553e77358f12b7814dcb540a4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [880], "source_xml_sha256": "89624cdf20bce3bfe79d0bbd8b87bfc72627cf366da9a28db365dfda1267c490", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0069", "text": "«Savez-vous pourquoi il vous avait suivie? reprit Gringoire, tâchant de revenir à sa question par un détour.", "sha256": "0a02a91cd9282ca1af069e9fcc0ca8a9a228b5fcc0c87603b7419225429afeaf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [881], "source_xml_sha256": "99773186328e0225c022c1a9be523f8f2be55ab461b392c66f85b9ad85610234", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0070", "text": "—Je ne sais pas», dit la jeune fille. Et elle ajouta vivement: «Mais vous qui me suiviez aussi, pourquoi me suiviez-vous?", "sha256": "428cb9a42a214a7efe09d4a390ddba1820cfc70db23ad30644bc7f8a52c20ed2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [882], "source_xml_sha256": "74cc16d9ce2cd88956b069488f3d9dd6d356babd8006144bc7ecb2c6901d4cc2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0071", "text": "—En bonne foi, répondit Gringoire, je ne sais pas non plus.»", "sha256": "095a1e5813a90fafe6857c64f192d275d1b78ca47af076fab8a18615fa546db7", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [883], "source_xml_sha256": "adca75d096488049c0463c730c3aecb40ab6e1560d9995b7505cea147c8e0665", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0072", "text": "Il y eut un silence. Gringoire tailladait la table avec son couteau. La jeune fille souriait et semblait regarder quelque chose à travers le mur. Tout à coup elle se prit à chanter d'une voix à peine articulée:", "sha256": "35c31a927ebf2a917f4a2e812e0dac441e4d3a5bb0c35a465390dd22232e5e18", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [884], "source_xml_sha256": "137935a2a75958163a1f38415b0c06fd5fbe175b1fce5dab423c9f1c4198c20d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0073", "text": "[[I]]Quando las pintadas aves[[/I]]
[[I]]Mudas están, y la tierra[[/I]][[N29]]...", "sha256": "e3139ac9f07f30a73240f7bfd25afcc9fee9ef566ac246d8fcdf0cde18167b7a", "role": "verse_group", "tag": "div", "source_physical_indices": [885], "source_xml_sha256": "ce5bb6d3b6049aad882b51195f8694f6bc303b71b5c9885224d0b25cee87eebe", "emphasis_spans": 2, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N29]]"], "source_lines": ["[[I]]Quando las pintadas aves[[/I]]", "[[I]]Mudas están, y la tierra[[/I]][[N29]]..."]}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0074", "text": "Elle s'interrompit brusquement, et se mit à caresser Djali.", "sha256": "1ecf75cdd112dbb2134a19d4641dab058b04e58fe163b32f994b05b66cb54f26", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [886], "source_xml_sha256": "643d8635bc634c4a12afff1ce5e6d76a49ffc188baa548a36b704260858de239", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0075", "text": "«Vous avez là une jolie bête, dit Gringoire.", "sha256": "3906f06003791f70a42d3ed7117bfea7ad00881aeadbb17eec2f266501cb32a1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [887], "source_xml_sha256": "4a170e0462ad68595424fb974181e87f741338124742dd06799c3d5a5f139deb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0076", "text": "—C'est ma sœur, répondit-elle.", "sha256": "bfdf2d54109d34b63e83ab6d6986d6ebaf52dddcbe7fdb86bd13dc28d784b78c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [888], "source_xml_sha256": "398e6020ebbb39c06ba2dc8f94a03740c566c7d0945b334fe1238416bedf8786", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0077", "text": "—Pourquoi vous appelle-t-on [[I]]la Esmeralda[[/I]]? demanda le poète.", "sha256": "2a2e1de6c02f41ac6bb591db562db7298fb23d3ccef754797bcda69aa9c0fcb4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [889], "source_xml_sha256": "28973ca044b9a08e780bee2bccc16deccd4eab849ae3f5253cf0c0fa0dd7d2e5", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0078", "text": "—Je n'en sais rien.", "sha256": "97ee30890b9b21f13edc2feabf13ac7d49f9a7f273666c1f58c1a5160e27deaf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [890], "source_xml_sha256": "4083d2996cf26833ab728a6aafc4d4e8b7c42f6a2a3f18f716f805bcdc5d9a14", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0079", "text": "—Mais encore?»", "sha256": "4251ca5d40453089f82191a02ed6b856817246da512d6b3f34079fa89f1f5982", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [891], "source_xml_sha256": "4fefa1e5d884988764b98b37dc4188d982ed42ecb13362090830e97a7ba1a690", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0080", "text": "Elle tira de son sein une espèce de petit sachet oblong suspendu à son cou par une chaîne de grains d'adrézarach. Ce sachet exhalait une forte odeur de camphre. Il était recouvert de soie verte, et portait à son centre une grosse verroterie verte, imitant l'émeraude.", "sha256": "a140910cb1342747f5c2eb7c949f45231e3a11596a60851950a2038d01466d55", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [892], "source_xml_sha256": "86d775922ad468219fb340afbfc253f85b1cd8cc2a0e0d904ae180a029801de5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0081", "text": "«C'est peut-être à cause de cela», dit-elle.", "sha256": "665d9a8d6dc6d0e71077beab30fbe59e22274b7abf4014d0666a95659ed3553d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [893], "source_xml_sha256": "d824c15e76a112c489102ab4d5c1d6e68c2db1c6702d1ebe417f3dd7752459a6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0082", "text": "Gringoire voulut prendre le sachet. Elle recula. «N'y touchez pas. C'est une amulette; tu ferais mal au charme, ou le charme à toi.»", "sha256": "35b1b1e81d22c44deb78fb40675a84c6d63982a666b0d3f57b8865ba0546f89e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [894], "source_xml_sha256": "4c507ea460d49c59ebcee0fee2fec094f6c71627ee025107bf7dac9c7db4e63a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0083", "text": "La curiosité du poète était de plus en plus éveillée.", "sha256": "dd67066b51fa4f0d05a5529f69f1d449d67645ce6bce21035bd8f5d2e97835ef", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [895], "source_xml_sha256": "569a99d2172675cae5cd383388d60962412c3421bb7c723747a2190af77eb990", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0084", "text": "«Qui vous l'a donnée?»", "sha256": "bd14779e0f807fdf2a3e06d7d9057a99281d36cbd67c3aa38ae9bb6d566c6beb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [896], "source_xml_sha256": "0e7522f6533f80f3c18f7a39a1a3ba1e37dc35a0cfaa0914ec8933108a5b335f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0085", "text": "Elle mit un doigt sur sa bouche et cacha l'amulette dans son sein. Il essaya d'autres questions, mais elle répondait à peine.", "sha256": "229a7a350984b5c3bb201c9244508540363e066a33be0ae40464fbc155618495", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [897], "source_xml_sha256": "08b337ece037d5fdfdec85dd4aefd48a072ae2d6b9e3390fc5f2937c05f50ea4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0086", "text": "«Que veut dire ce mot: [[I]]la Esmeralda[[/I]]?", "sha256": "0381ae5674588906a4c692d4960da889e663c202da5311b2027e7638077a6c76", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [898], "source_xml_sha256": "bda6b1b318384f62944547596250d0fb331bf6e905056a57e8db90525981f317", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0087", "text": "—Je ne sais pas, dit-elle.", "sha256": "b0d8874ed02eaab3b98172b85fc3897aaf6e0c8f8d48be7e8433507eefad92a6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [899], "source_xml_sha256": "2f770e667c53a47048cba82db41bbe358c0f6ac1027c448a665ae2fb3812d480", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0088", "text": "—À quelle langue appartient-il?", "sha256": "cfc9360c979ad6e7eb1503dbeac34af985853823af5548ab7c3228b410d93f95", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [900], "source_xml_sha256": "6b1105d7503e0291be99b6cfedf0d0fdf3744c83bf217b83becbdede21d89bc3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0089", "text": "—C'est de l'égyptien, je crois.", "sha256": "50580bfecd327ca92b2276c88b8b376360d5bd46d014ede3c2b7a0a42cab8803", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [901], "source_xml_sha256": "e40381d53a9cc986ef081b75cbb9d0b15c53d9d58edeb1ae8eb6149b9f4f9ae5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0090", "text": "—Je m'en étais douté, dit Gringoire, vous n'êtes pas de France?", "sha256": "a4da198c76b2dc87d0123869f31fb9ea7cf58c48f919097b18dd5b676b180f6f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [902], "source_xml_sha256": "67bc4c32b630149e89382f0c2d078d4d035bca571d2c6530f9e16e01ae06eef5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0091", "text": "—Je n'en sais rien.", "sha256": "97ee30890b9b21f13edc2feabf13ac7d49f9a7f273666c1f58c1a5160e27deaf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [903], "source_xml_sha256": "4083d2996cf26833ab728a6aafc4d4e8b7c42f6a2a3f18f716f805bcdc5d9a14", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0092", "text": "—Avez-vous vos parents?»", "sha256": "5e5b2965dc556b772a10ab7d67d2255428c68eb35935fc3a132fe857920eb942", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [904], "source_xml_sha256": "f7c686bca87303deef11758d86f9f9c36f486e355765311e57153bc602dcc314", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0093", "text": "Elle se mit à chanter sur un vieil air:", "sha256": "c56d58c9dbed19b62a3c3da9c3f25c45cbf541feaa177e2fb9322bb28ad66793", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [905], "source_xml_sha256": "631b1b382495d5d3642a5642d280b370049d77c434d3d9695286d01e33a1d9c3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0094", "text": "[[I]]Mon père est oiseau,[[/I]]
[[I]]Ma mère est oiselle,[[/I]]
[[I]]Je passe l'eau sans nacelle,[[/I]]
[[I]]Je passe l'eau sans bateau,[[/I]]
[[I]]Ma mère est oiselle.[[/I]]
[[I]]Mon père est oiseau.[[/I]]", "sha256": "64040e7520456996064b8c294aceb3e27c3c6740fb8c3a6b8840209ee21bc173", "role": "verse_group", "tag": "div", "source_physical_indices": [906], "source_xml_sha256": "2a4baeb3d0042adef6c921e9533b3cc589b15c4a7cb212bb111765b110d5b20a", "emphasis_spans": 6, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_lines": ["[[I]]Mon père est oiseau,[[/I]]", "[[I]]Ma mère est oiselle,[[/I]]", "[[I]]Je passe l'eau sans nacelle,[[/I]]", "[[I]]Je passe l'eau sans bateau,[[/I]]", "[[I]]Ma mère est oiselle.[[/I]]", "[[I]]Mon père est oiseau.[[/I]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u015-b0095", "text": "«C'est bon, dit Gringoire. À quel âge êtes-vous venue en France?", "sha256": "0101f2ccc43b6d9e4e43d22a900dee038e5b843c6f71282c82a1ff1586413c8f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [907], "source_xml_sha256": "a97cebf28c5fdf03a4a6778e0042ecf93d4be6e06d4f5342d2f9901eda72be49", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
